_source.name: Big Ass Data Broker Opt-Out List (BADBOOL)
_source.author: Yael Writes
_source.notes: Transcribed from the 'People Search Sites' section only. 'Special Circumstances' and 'Preventing Identity Theft & Opting Out of Marketing Sites' sections were intentionally skipped as they are not individual broker entries. priority is mapped from BADBOOL symbols: crucial (was the flower symbol), high (was the skull symbol), normal (unmarked). requires_id is true only where the source marked the ticket/ID symbol; costs_money is true only where the source marked the money-bag symbol.

brokers.name: BeenVerified
brokers.notes: Property search opt-out: https://www.beenverified.com/app/optout/address-search. Also owns PeopleLooker and PeopleSmart. One opt-out per email address — email for additional removals. Confirm via emailed link.

brokers.name: CheckPeople
brokers.notes: You can request a data copy first at the privacy rights page (checkpeople.com/privacy-rights). Required: birthdate and full legal name.

brokers.name: Clustal
brokers.notes: Click "view full record" on your listing to grab its URL, then enter it plus your email on the Privacy Control page. Multiple listings require different email addresses. Confirm via emailed link.

brokers.name: Intelius
brokers.notes: Alternatives: email support@mailer.intelius.com or call 1-888-245-1655. Also owns Addresses.com, Addresssearch.com, Anywho, Classmates, DateCheck, Instant Checkmate, InstantPeopleFinder, iSearch, LookUpAnyone, Peopleconnect.us, PeopleFinder, PeopleLookup, Phonesbook, Publicrecords, Spock, Truthfinder, US Search, and Zabasearch — the suppression.peopleconnect.us portal may cover several of these brands in one request.

brokers.name: Men Stopping Violence
brokers.notes: Enter your listing URL on the opt-out page, click "remove my info", add your email address, then confirm via the emailed link.

brokers.name: MyLife
brokers.notes: Must pick up a phone for one alternative path. Email alternative: privacy@mylife.com with your name and profile link. Previous phone option (888) 704-1900 ext. 2 — status unclear. A free membership sign-up can also remove your reputation profile. Notoriously slow and pushy about paid upsells — never pay for a basic opt-out.

brokers.name: Nuwber
brokers.notes: Use "filter by state" to isolate your listing URL. If you run into problems, screenshot the results and email support@nuwber.com.

brokers.name: Radaris
brokers.notes: If a "View Profile" button exists, copy the URL and use the control-privacy form. If it doesn't, email customer-service@radaris.com with a screenshot instead. May need multiple follow-ups.

brokers.name: SmartBackgroundChecks
brokers.notes: This opt-out also removes your listing from PeopleFinders.

brokers.name: Spokeo
brokers.notes: Scroll to the "opt out your information" section, then confirm via the emailed link. Paid Spokeo accounts may retain removed information.

brokers.name: That's Them
brokers.notes: Don't click the Spokeo "identity theft" link shown on this site — it's a paid upsell product, not part of the free opt-out.

brokers.name: White Pages
brokers.notes: Must pick up a phone: requires a phone call to get an opt-out verification code, and may need an automated voice call. Additional options and a request form at support.whitepages.com. Also covers 411.com (same opt-out process). Check Whitepages Premium separately.

brokers.name: Acxiom
brokers.notes: Country-specific portals for France, Italy, Spain, and the U.S. (acxiom.com/privacy/{fr,it,es} and /optout/). Austria, Germany, India, Switzerland: email Datenschutz@acxiom.com. Other international: Acxiom Consumer International Rights Portal (OneTrust). No email option? Call (877) 774-2094.

brokers.name: AdvancedBackgroundChecks
brokers.notes: You can leave city, state, and age blank when searching. Verify via date of birth or address during opt-out.

brokers.name: Ancestry.com
brokers.notes: Sign up for a free account (not a free trial), search for your info, click each state you've lived in, copy all the profile URLs, and email them to privacy@ancestry.com. Alternative: the content removal form linked here.

brokers.name: FastPeopleSearch.com
brokers.notes: May require solving a CAPTCHA.

brokers.name: USPhoneBook
brokers.notes: If the opt-out link hangs, email support+optout@usphonebook.com.

brokers.name: Archives
brokers.notes: Requires signing up for a free trial first (remember to cancel it), then opt out if your data is found.

brokers.name: Classmates.com
brokers.notes: Owned by Intelius/PeopleConnect — cancel your membership via the linked help center article. See also the Intelius entry.

brokers.name: Facecheck
brokers.notes: Reverse face-image search. Removal requires uploading a driver's license/ID (hide sensitive fields) or a selfie with two fingers on your chin. Doesn't remove your info from the original source websites; there's an exception process for violent criminals.

brokers.name: FamilySearch
brokers.notes: Sign up for a free account, search historical records, copy the record URLs, then submit the opt-out form and verify your email address.

brokers.name: FreePeopleDirectory
brokers.notes: This site's opt-out is handled through Spokeo's opt-out page — scroll to the "opt out your information" section there.

brokers.name: InfoTracer
brokers.notes: Alternative: mail the printable opt-out form (available from members.infotracer.com) or fax it to 1-617-933-9946.

brokers.name: National Public Data
brokers.notes: Copy your unique record URL, paste it into the opt-out form, share your email, and verify via the emailed link.

brokers.name: OpenDataUSA
brokers.notes: Includes personal info and political donation records. Check the box next to each record to remove, click "Remove Selected", then fill in name/address/email/relationship. Only recognizes Gmail, Yahoo, Outlook, and other major email providers. Click "confirm and remove" in the emailed confirmation.

brokers.name: PeopleByName
brokers.notes: Lookup URL format: peoplebyname.com/people/[Last_Name]/[First_Name]. Opt out separately for each record found.

brokers.name: PimEyes
brokers.notes: Face-recognition reverse image search. Requires a face photo plus an ID photo (blur sensitive fields — keep your name and photo visible) and an email address. Use Signal, Photoshop, or a physical method to blur ID fields before uploading.

brokers.name: PrivateEye
brokers.notes: After you initiate opt-out you'll receive a record removal form to complete.

brokers.name: PrivateRecords
brokers.notes: Search by name and state.

brokers.name: PropertyRecs
brokers.notes: Search by name and state; opt out from the same page if you find a listing.

brokers.name: Rehold
brokers.notes: Look up your home address, click the red "remove" button on your listing, enter name and email, and solve a CAPTCHA.

brokers.name: Searchbug
brokers.notes: Requires a credit card to search (first search free). Opt out via the contact form/chat, phone/text (760) 454-7301, or fax (760) 454-7341.

brokers.name: SearchPeopleFree
brokers.notes: Searchable by name, phone, address, or email.

brokers.name: SearchQuarry
brokers.notes: Click the verification link sent to your inbox to complete the opt-out.

brokers.name: Social Catfish
brokers.notes: Record the URL for each profile you find. On the opt-out page, scroll to the URL/email/phone/address removal instructions — only request removal for information that's actually visible. Provide your email and click the confirmation link.

brokers.name: SpyFly
brokers.notes: Alternative: email support@spyfly.com. Required: name, age, address, email. Verify the data actually exists before providing your info.

brokers.name: TruePeopleSearch.com
brokers.notes: Enter name, city, state, and email. Solve multiple CAPTCHAs before your info is removed.

brokers.name: TruePeopleSearch.net
brokers.notes: Unrelated to truepeoplesearch.com despite the similar name. Close any extra pages that open and ignore "top rated" links. Opt out via the linked Google Form with your URL and information.

brokers.name: Unite4Heritage
brokers.notes: Search using first and last name only. Paste the URL into the opt-out page, click "submit opt-out request", enter your email, then click "confirm request" in the emailed confirmation.

brokers.name: United States Phone Book
brokers.notes: Removal requires entering the phone number and zip code to remove.

brokers.name: UnMask
brokers.notes: Enter name, city, and state. You'll receive a confirmation email with a removal link. Solve CAPTCHAs as prompted.

brokers.name: Veripages
brokers.notes: Enter your profile URL, provide name and email, solve a CAPTCHA, then confirm via the emailed link.

brokers.name: VoterRecords
brokers.notes: Find your listing, scroll to the bottom, and click the "record opt-out" link. Submit the form and verify via email if a confirmation is sent.

brokers.name: ZoomInfo
brokers.notes: Fill out the form to check whether you're listed, then opt out if an email is on record — you'll receive a verification code via email. ZoomInfo's focus is shifting toward business/professional data rather than general consumer search.
